title: 石桥难民包个案工作者培训
instruction:
您是 Selma Rutkowski，难民健康护士执业者，就 Tanneryside Studios 交付的抵达支持合同向 Stonebridge 委员会提供咨询。卡米尔·埃克斯特罗姆 (Kamil Ekstrom) 需要在下午4:00 之前准备好社工培训包。 8 月23，因此它可以被批准用于 9 月份的队列，并在第一次机场接机前的员工聚会中使用。 Tanneryside 每年都会在其明尼苏达州德卢斯和威斯康星州苏必利尔市的团队中引进大约300 的新人。其个案工作人员不是临床医生，但在从机场到公寓的一周内，他们通常是第一批打开家庭海外体检包、注意其分类和疫苗接种记录并安排初步预约的当地工作人员。他们现在使用的临时简报是口头脚本，因主管而异，Stonebridge 董事会已授权您将其替换为受控培训包，于 9 月3 生效。替代者需要在合同中清楚地记录这一变化，以便 Felix Dalgaard 能够确定哪些指导是最新的，而无需将材料转化为法律备忘录。眼前的问题不是工作人员不愿意安排护理，而是员工不愿意安排护理。他们试图通过他们只部分理解的标签来提供帮助。
一些工作人员一直在使用一条经验法则，即每个以“B”开头的符号都可以等待普通的新来者预约，而其他人则将任何肺部符号视为一个人患有活动性结核病的证据。这种捷径不适用于该计划收到的数据包，但工作人员仍然需要一种实用的方法来决定他们可以自己安排什么，什么需要临床或公共卫生协调，以及什么是紧急情况，而不会陷入诊断或分类。最近，一名孩子的文书工作上的B1肺部注释被重复给住房联系人“孩子患有结核病”，这正是该计划必须防止出现的那种未经证实的陈述。疫苗接种栏中的空白也会产生类似的问题：一些工作人员称其为未接种疫苗的证据，而其他人则完全忽略疫苗接种页面。培训必须让非临床个案工作者自信地行事，同时保持每一个简化都符合海外记录可以和不能建立的内容。还有一种罕见但重要的到达途径，涉及 A 级结核病符号和豁免。
卡米尔不希望这种可能性被隐藏在常规指导中，因为工作人员可能会将包裹放入正常的预约队列中，但他也不希望出现令人恐惧的情况，导致社工隔离家庭、取消交通、警告房东或声称具有传染性。同样的限制对于心理健康、行为、性传播感染和其他 A 类或 B 类符号也很重要：该计划需要操作指导，而不是在需要的人之外重复标签。个案工作者可能会遇到患有重病或在抵达期间表示有立即受到伤害的风险的人，但包裹本身并不能代替对他们面前发生的事情做出反应。 Tanneryside 为明尼苏达州和威斯康星州边境两侧提供服务，家庭的公寓、接收诊所和公共卫生交接处并不总是与机场接机处于同一状态。卡米尔希望该方案能够使管辖权区分变得可用，而不意味着联邦海外分类会改变州界线的含义，也不会发明州的截止日期、法律授权或未经批准的联系方式。塞尔玛仍然是该合同的指定临床升级点，而紧急服务仍然是立即紧急情况的路线。
当地诊所和公共卫生联系人目录正在重新协商，因此故意不包含在本次发布中，因此请使用稳定的基于角色的指示，而不是未经验证的名称或号码。卡米尔和菲利克斯尚未确定最好的处理方法是采用具有明确标记的明尼苏达州和威斯康星州分支的单一通用工作流程，还是在相同材料内采用两条明显独立的州道。这两种方法都可以，但要慎重地做出选择，并让第一天的个案工作人员清楚地了解哪种方法适用。制作`caseworker_training_deck.pdf`，一个面向办案人员的不超过10幻灯片的幻灯片，以及`first_week_action_key.docx`，一个单页办公桌钥匙，可以在打开包裹时使用。该牌组应适合由非临床主管领导的20分钟的聚会，并且钥匙在由从未见过海外医疗包的新社工单独使用时必须仍然有效。使用简单、非侮辱性的语言，将个人健康信息保持在安排和升级所需的最低限度，并且不要复制真实的患者包或包含识别病例的详细信息。两个文件中出现的任何分类含义、调度窗口、升级时间或其他数字必须完全一致。
包括简明的生效日期或修订声明，表明该包取代临时口头简报，但不要添加应用程序屏幕截图、计费说明、临床治疗建议或详尽的移民法解释。没有附件；使用您的难民健康实践知识并保持所有示例的综合性。准确使用给定的文件名将这两个文件写入工作目录的顶层。

---

将您完成的工作写入**当前工作目录的顶层**，使用以下文件名：

- `caseworker_training_deck.pdf` — 面向社会工作者的培训平台，供 20 分钟的员工在抵达第一周挤在一起使用海外医疗包信息。 （不超过10幻灯片/页；适合非临床主管的协助；对明尼苏达州和威斯康星州操作有效；必须同意共享标签、图形和时间安排上的行动要点。）
- `first_week_action_key.docx` — 一页独立操作键，可供第一天的社工在安排第一周服务时使用海外医疗包。 （完全是一个渲染页面；无需套牌即可使用；必须与套牌在共享标签、图形和时间安排上达成一致。）

除了这些文件名之外，不会收集任何内容。在其他地方或以任何其他名称编写的正确文件得分为零。

Situation: A packet for the correctly matched child shows “Class B1 pulmonary TB.” The family will reside in Wisconsin after a Duluth airport pickup. The child

gold.text:
FIRST-WEEK ACTION KEY  Overseas medical packet actions for nonclinical caseworkers
Effective September 3 | Controlled release: replaces the interim verbal briefing | Clinical owner and escalation point: Selma Rutkowski
1  IMMEDIATE EMERGENCY
2  RARE EXCEPTION
3  PRIORITIZED
4  ORDINARY
Emergency services first for severe breathing difficulty, unresponsiveness, another immediate medical emergency, or an immediate threat of self-harm or harm to others. Current presentation changes the response regardless of the packet.
Class A TB with a waiver: same-day coordinate with Selma and the appropriate public-health role. Keep outside the ordinary appointment queue. Do not decide infectiousness, isolate, cancel ordinary transport automatically, warn housing, or make exposure notices.
TB follow-up notation or other finding flagged for follow-up: promptly coordinate with Selma / receiving clinical-public-health role before ordinary screening. Letter alone is not priority or severity.
Arrange ordinary domestic screening in 30–90 days after arrival. Higher-priority findings override. A historical behavioral notation alone is not a present emergency.

OPEN • PRESERVE • RELAYCLASS A / B: FAST MEANING
Before acting, verify the packet belongs to the correct person: match name plus date of birth or another packet identifier. Copy no more identifiers than needed.
Do not alter, annotate over, discard, or separate original overseas medical records. Securely store and transmit; never use personal email, open messaging, or unattended copies.
Record and relay the exact classification / annotation (secure record attached when appropriate). Do not paraphrase into a diagnosis. Missing, damaged, mismatched, or unreadable? Secure it and escalate to Selma / appropriate receiving role; do not guess or reconstruct.
Class A: overseas immigration medical classification associated with an inadmissible condition unless an applicable waiver or resolution permits travel. Arrival can occur through an authorized waiver or other documented clearance pathway; it is not a universal statement of present infectiousness.
Class B: significant condition, finding, or departure from normal health warranting follow-up; not itself an inadmissible Class A condition and not, by itself, active or contagious disease.
Mental-health or behavioral Class A/B notations need careful clinical follow-up; they do not by themselves establish current dangerousness.
TB: READ EXACTLY, THEN ROUTEVACCINATION DOCUMENTATION
Class B0 pulmonary TB: TB disease diagnosed overseas; treatment completed under the applicable overseas process before departure. Prioritized follow-up; do not recast as untreated active TB.
Class B1 pulmonary TB: findings/history require domestic follow-up without an overseas diagnosis of infectious TB disease at departure. Prioritized follow-up. Does not mean active TB or authorize calling the person contagious.
Class B1 extrapulmonary TB: distinct notation requiring follow-up; not synonymous with pulmonary infectiousness. Prioritized follow-up.
Class B2 TB: latent TB infection evaluation, not active TB disease. Prioritized follow-up.
Class B3 TB: evaluation as contact of a known TB case; proves neither infection nor disease. Prioritized follow-up; no caseworker exposure notices.
DS-3025 is overseas vaccination documentation, not a complete domestic immunization assessment. A blank field does not prove a vaccine was never given. Entries may be dates or medically relevant reasons no dose was given (for example, not age appropriate, contraindication, insufficient interval, unavailable vaccine).
Do not fill blanks from memory, family statements, or assumptions. Unclear/incomplete documentation: arrange clinical review or immunization assessment, not a caseworker compliance conclusion.
SELECT THE STATE ROUTEMINIMUM-NECESSARY HANDOFFCLOSE THE LOOP
Choose the Minnesota or Wisconsin route by the family’s residence or receiving-care location, not airport pickup location alone.
MINNESOTA residence / receiving care: route to the Minnesota receiving clinic and appropriate Minnesota public-health role.
WISCONSIN residence / receiving care: route to the Wisconsin receiving clinic and appropriate Wisconsin public-health role.
Federal overseas classification meaning does not change across states. Use the controlled directory for contacts; do not invent deadlines, legal mandates, or contacts. Uncertain, conflicting, or cross-border? Escalate to Selma; do not guess.
Share classifications only with the receiving clinical/public-health role that needs them. Do not share packet diagnoses or classifications with landlords, housing staff, employers, transport providers, or other people who do not need the information.
Use a qualified interpreter for health-related communication when needed - not a child or untrained bystander.
Say: “The overseas record contains a Class B1 pulmonary TB classification requiring follow-up. I can send the record securely to the receiving role.”
Document date/status, destination role, appointment or escalation outcome, and exact packet label relayed - never a caseworker diagnosis. Missed, declined, or failed connection: document, re-engage respectfully, and escalate to Selma / receiving staff.

criteria.description: 这两个文件在正常查看或打印尺寸下仍然清晰可辨，并使用支持快速扫描的视觉层次结构。

original.criterion: Both files remain legible at normal viewing or print size and use visual hierarchy that supports rapid scanning.
original.grader_hint: Review typography, contrast, spacing, and information density; credit only if neither file requires zooming or deciphering dense prose.

criteria.description: 该软件包是为非临床个案工作者而不是临床医生、律师或患者编写的。
criteria.evidence: 两个文件中的语言、示例和说明。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找简单的操作语言和不可避免的临床术语的解释。

original.criterion: The package is written for nonclinical caseworkers rather than clinicians, lawyers, or patients.
original.evidence: Language, examples, and instructions throughout both files.
original.grader_hint: Look for plain operational language and explanations of unavoidable clinical terminology.

criteria.description: 该套牌明确将个案工作者的角色限制为观察、记录、安排、保护信息和升级，而不是诊断或治疗。
criteria.grader_hint: 仅当允许的行为和诊断/治疗边界明确时才接受等效措辞。

original.criterion: The deck explicitly limits the caseworker role to observing, recording, scheduling, safeguarding information, and escalating rather than diagnosing or treating.
original.grader_hint: Accept equivalent wording only if both permitted actions and the diagnostic/treatment boundary are clear.

criteria.description: 该方案有意采用与州分支机构共同的工作流程或明显分开的明尼苏达州和威斯康星州车道，并且所选择的结构是明确无误的。
criteria.evidence: 两个可交付成果中的管辖权组织。
criteria.grader_hint: 任一种有合理依据的设计都可得满分；不要强制要求使用某一个特定模型。

original.criterion: The package deliberately adopts either a common workflow with state branches or visibly separate Minnesota and Wisconsin lanes, and the chosen structure is unmistakable.
original.grader_hint: Either defensible design earns full credit; do not require one particular model.

criteria.description: 该套牌具有连贯的教学进程，可以由非临床主管在 20 分钟的时间内讲授。
criteria.grader_hint: 相信从目的和边界到数据包解释到行动和实践的进展；拒绝仅词汇表的信息转储。

original.criterion: The deck has a coherent instructional progression that can be delivered in a 20-minute huddle by a nonclinical supervisor.
original.evidence: Sequence and density of the deck.
original.grader_hint: Credit a progression from purpose and boundaries through packet interpretation to action and practice; reject a glossary-only information dump.

criteria.description: 该套牌为学习者提供了至少一次将指导应用到合成数据包场景的机会。

criteria.grader_hint: 演习必须要求安排、升级、隐私或沟通决策，而不是临床诊断。

original.criterion: The deck gives the learner at least one opportunity to apply the guidance to a synthetic packet scenario.
original.evidence: Scenario, knowledge check, or facilitated exercise in the deck.
original.grader_hint: The exercise must ask for a scheduling, escalation, privacy, or communication decision rather than clinical diagnosis.

criteria.description: 任何学习者练习都包括解释安全操作和数据包证据限制的答案或汇报。
criteria.evidence: 在甲板上回答或协调员汇报。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认学习者无需咨询作者即可验证推理。

original.criterion: Any learner exercise includes an answer or debrief that explains the safe action and the limit of the packet evidence.
original.evidence: Answer or facilitator debrief in the deck.
original.grader_hint: Confirm the learner can verify the reasoning without consulting the author.

criteria.description: 这些材料指示工作人员在采取行动之前验证该数据包属于正确的人。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找最低限度的身份匹配，例如姓名加出生日期或其他数据包标识符，而无需进行不必要的复制。

original.criterion: The materials direct staff to verify that the packet belongs to the correct person before acting on it.
original.grader_hint: Look for a minimum identity match such as name plus date of birth or another packet identifier, without requiring unnecessary copying.

criteria.description: 这些材料需要准确地转录或转述分类和注释，而不是解释为诊断。
criteria.grader_hint: 信用措辞，例如准确引用标签、附加安全记录或不将B1翻译为活动TB。

original.criterion: The materials require classifications and annotations to be transcribed or relayed exactly rather than paraphrased into a diagnosis.
original.grader_hint: Credit wording such as quote the label exactly, attach the secure record, or do not translate B1 into active TB.

criteria.description: 该包裹告诉工作人员不要更改、注释、丢弃或分离原始海外病历。
criteria.grader_hint: 等效的保存语言是可以接受的。

original.criterion: The package tells staff not to alter, annotate over, discard, or separate original overseas medical records.
original.grader_hint: Equivalent preservation language is acceptable.

criteria.description: 该包裹为丢失、损坏、不匹配或无法读取的包裹提供了安全途径，无需要求社会工作者重建其内容。
criteria.evidence: 甲板或钥匙中的异常处理。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找安全升级到塞尔玛或适当的接收角色以及不要猜测的指示。

original.criterion: The package provides a safe route for a missing, damaged, mismatched, or unreadable packet without asking the caseworker to reconstruct its contents.
original.evidence: Exception handling in deck or key.
original.grader_hint: Look for secure escalation to Selma or the appropriate receiving role and an instruction not to guess.

criteria.description: A 类被准确地描述为与不可接受的情况相关的海外移民医疗分类，除非适用的弃权或决议允许旅行，而不是作为当前传染性的普遍声明。
criteria.grader_hint: 措辞可以简化，但必须保留移民意义和临床推断的限制。

original.criterion: Class A is accurately described as an overseas immigration medical classification associated with an inadmissible condition unless an applicable waiver or resolution permits travel, not as a universal statement of present infectiousness.
original.grader_hint: The wording may be simplified but must preserve both immigration significance and the limit on what can be inferred clinically.

criteria.description: 这些材料解释说，根据授权豁免或其他记录在案的通关途径，一个人可能会带着 A 级标志抵达。
criteria.evidence: A 级或罕见例外指导。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找为什么可以获得 A 级标签的明确原因。

original.criterion: The materials explain that a person may arrive with a Class A notation under an authorized waiver or other documented clearance pathway.
original.grader_hint: Look for an explicit reason why arrival with a Class A label is possible.

criteria.description: B 类被准确地描述为需要随访的重大健康状况、发现或偏离正常健康状况，但其本身并不是不可接受的 A 类状况。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受准确区分 B 类重要性和 A 类不可接受性的简洁措辞。

original.criterion: Class B is accurately described as a significant health condition, finding, or departure from normal health that warrants follow-up but is not itself an inadmissible Class A condition.
original.grader_hint: Accept concise wording that accurately separates Class B significance from Class A inadmissibility.

criteria.description: 该包明确指出，B 类符号本身并不是活动性或传染性疾病的诊断。
criteria.grader_hint: 这种区别必须足够直接，以防止社会工作者重新标记此人。

original.criterion: The package explicitly states that a Class B notation is not, by itself, a diagnosis of active or contagious disease.
original.grader_hint: This distinction must be direct enough to prevent a caseworker from relabeling the person.

criteria.description: A 类和 B 类解释避免将字母单独呈现为完整的调度优先级或临床严重程度量表。
criteria.grader_hint: 如果具体条件、符号、弃权状态、当前陈述和接收途径决定了行动而不是仅由信件决定，则应予以信用。

original.criterion: The Class A and B explanations avoid presenting the letter alone as a complete scheduling priority or clinical severity scale.
original.grader_hint: Credit if the specific condition, notation, waiver status, current presentation, and receiving pathway determine action rather than the letter alone.

criteria.description: B0类肺结核准确区分为在境外确诊的结核病，并在出发前按照境外适用流程完成治疗。
criteria.grader_hint: 该材料不得将B0合并为B1或将其描述为未经治疗的活动性结核病。

original.criterion: Class B0 pulmonary TB is accurately distinguished as TB disease diagnosed overseas with treatment completed under the applicable overseas process before departure.
original.grader_hint: The material must not merge B0 into B1 or describe it as untreated active TB.

criteria.description: B1 级肺结核准确地与需要国内随访的发现或病史联系起来，而在出发时无需在海外诊断出传染性结核病。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受简化的语言，保留后续的需要，并且不存在数据包支持的活动性传染性结核病诊断。

original.criterion: Class B1 pulmonary TB is accurately tied to findings or history requiring domestic follow-up without an overseas diagnosis of infectious TB disease at departure.
original.grader_hint: Accept simplified language that preserves the need for follow-up and the absence of a packet-supported active infectious TB diagnosis.

criteria.description: 材料直接指出，B1肺部感染并不意味着该人患有活动性结核病，并且没有授权个案工作者称该人具有传染性。
criteria.evidence: B1 肺部解释或沟通警告。
criteria.grader_hint: 诊断和传染性限制都必须显而易见。

original.criterion: The materials directly state that B1 pulmonary does not mean the person has active TB and does not authorize the caseworker to call the person contagious.
original.evidence: B1 pulmonary explanation or communication warning.
original.grader_hint: Both the diagnosis and contagiousness limits must be apparent.

criteria.description: B1 类肺外结核被确定为需要随访的独特符号，而不是被视为肺部传染性的同义词。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找肺外B1的明确描述或操作行。

original.criterion: Class B1 extrapulmonary TB is identified as a distinct notation requiring follow-up rather than being treated as synonymous with pulmonary infectiousness.
original.grader_hint: Look for a distinct description or action row for extrapulmonary B1.

criteria.description: B2 级结核病与潜伏性结核病感染评估准确相关，而不是与活动性结核病相关。
criteria.grader_hint: 应出现术语“潜伏性结核感染”或准确的通俗语言等效术语。

original.criterion: Class B2 TB is accurately associated with latent TB infection evaluation rather than active TB disease.
original.grader_hint: The term latent TB infection or an accurate plain-language equivalent should appear.

criteria.description: B3 级结核病与作为已知结核病病例的接触者的评估准确相关，而不是与感染或疾病的证据相关。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认联系状态和推理限制均已传达。

original.criterion: Class B3 TB is accurately associated with evaluation as a contact of a known TB case rather than proof of infection or disease.
original.grader_hint: Confirm the contact status and the limit on inference are both conveyed.

criteria.description: 结核病分类被转化为有区别的个案工作者行动，而不是仅以定义形式呈现。
criteria.evidence: TB 操作表、流程或状态通道。
criteria.grader_hint: 学习者应该能够区分常规调度、优先临床协调、罕见升级和无需诊断的紧急响应。

original.criterion: The TB classifications are translated into differentiated caseworker actions rather than presented only as definitions.
original.evidence: TB action table, flow, or state lanes.
original.grader_hint: The learner should be able to distinguish routine scheduling, prioritized clinical coordination, rare escalation, and emergency response without diagnosing.

criteria.description: 具有豁免的 A 级 TB 是一种罕见的单独例外，不得进入普通预约队列。
criteria.evidence: 甲板和/或钥匙中的罕见例外指导。
criteria.grader_hint: 该例外必须在视觉上或口头上与一般结核病指导分开，并具有独特的行动。

original.criterion: Class A TB with a waiver is presented as a rare, separate exception that must not enter the ordinary appointment queue.
original.evidence: Rare-exception guidance in deck and/or key.
original.grader_hint: The exception must be visually or verbally separate from general TB guidance and have a distinct action.

criteria.description: A 级结核病豁免途径指导与塞尔玛的当天迅速协调以及适当的公共卫生角色，同时保持紧急情况升级以应对紧急情况。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受同等的同工作日语言。该指示不得告诉社会工作者做出传染性判定。

original.criterion: The Class A TB waiver pathway directs prompt same-day coordination with Selma and the appropriate public-health role while preserving emergency escalation for an immediate emergency.
original.grader_hint: Accept equivalent same-business-day language. The instruction must not tell the caseworker to make an infectiousness determination.

criteria.description: 罕见的 A 级结核病指南并未指示社会工作者实施隔离、自动取消普通交通、通知住房联系人或自行发出暴露通知。
criteria.evidence: A 级结核病动作语言。
criteria.grader_hint: 当该途径明确将临床和公共卫生决策交给授权专业人员时，授予学分。

original.criterion: The rare Class A TB guidance does not instruct caseworkers to impose isolation, cancel ordinary transport automatically, notify housing contacts, or make exposure notifications on their own authority.
original.grader_hint: Award credit when the pathway clearly places clinical and public-health decisions with authorized professionals.

criteria.description: 该包裹明确表示，无论包裹上写了什么，当前的症状或直接的安全问题都可能改变反应。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找数据包与当前条件的明确区别。

original.criterion: The package makes clear that current symptoms or an immediate safety concern can change the response regardless of what the packet says.
original.grader_hint: Look for an explicit packet-versus-current-condition distinction.

criteria.description: 紧急指南指导工作人员因严重呼吸困难、反应迟钝或其他紧急医疗紧急情况前往紧急服务机构。
criteria.grader_hint: 示例不必详尽，但响应必须立即且明确。

original.criterion: The emergency guidance directs staff to emergency services for severe breathing difficulty, unresponsiveness, or another immediate medical emergency.
original.grader_hint: The examples need not be exhaustive, but the response must be immediate and unambiguous.

criteria.description: 紧急情况指南单独解决了自残或伤害他人的直接威胁，而不将历史行为符号视为当前的紧急情况。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认当前观察到的风险（而不是单独的数据包标签）触发了紧急行动。

original.criterion: The emergency guidance separately addresses an immediate threat of self-harm or harm to others without treating a historical behavioral notation as a present emergency.
original.grader_hint: Confirm that current observed risk, not the packet label alone, triggers emergency action.

criteria.description: 这些材料不会将个案工作者变成症状筛查者，也不会提供超出其职责的临床决策规则。
criteria.grader_hint: 对明显紧急情况的简单识别是可以接受的；诊断检查表、医疗许可和临床分诊说明则不包括在内。

original.criterion: The materials do not turn caseworkers into symptom screeners or provide a clinical decision rule that exceeds their role.
original.grader_hint: Plain recognition of obvious emergencies is acceptable; diagnostic checklists, medical clearance, and clinical triage instructions are not.

criteria.description: 疫苗接种记录被认定为境外疫苗接种文件，如DS-3025，而不是作为完整的国内免疫评估呈现。
criteria.grader_hint: 查找表格名称或准确的描述以及完整性限制。

original.criterion: The vaccination record is identified as the overseas vaccination documentation, such as DS-3025, without presenting it as a complete domestic immunization assessment.
original.grader_hint: Look for the form name or an accurate description plus the limitation on completeness.

criteria.description: 包装上明确指出，空白疫苗接种字段并不能证明从未接种过疫苗。
criteria.grader_hint: 该限制必须是第一天的个案工作人员直接且可以理解的。

original.criterion: The package explicitly states that a blank vaccination field does not prove that a vaccine was never given.
original.grader_hint: The limit must be direct and understandable to a day-one caseworker.

criteria.description: 该包裹告诉社会工作者不要根据记忆、家庭陈述或假设来填写空白的疫苗接种字段。
criteria.grader_hint: 相信任何明确的指示，将解释和记录完成留给合格的临床人员。

original.criterion: The package tells caseworkers not to fill blank vaccination fields from memory, family statements, or assumptions.
original.grader_hint: Credit any explicit instruction to leave interpretation and record completion to qualified clinical staff.

criteria.description: 疫苗接种解释认识到，条目可能会记录未给予剂量的日期或医学相关原因，而不是将每个非日期条目视为拒绝。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受诸如年龄不适合、禁忌症、间隔时间不足或无法获得疫苗等例子；不需要完整的列表。

original.criterion: The vaccination explanation recognizes that entries may document dates or medically relevant reasons a dose was not given, rather than treating every non-date entry as refusal.
original.grader_hint: Accept examples such as not age appropriate, contraindication, insufficient interval, or unavailable vaccine; a complete list is not required.

criteria.description: 不明确或不完整的疫苗接种文件会导致临床审查或免疫评估，而不是社会工作者关于依从性的结论。
criteria.grader_hint: 接收诊所或塞尔玛可能是审查目的地。

original.criterion: Unclear or incomplete vaccination documentation leads to clinical review or immunization assessment, not a caseworker conclusion about compliance.
original.grader_hint: The receiving clinic or Selma may be the review destination.

criteria.description: 这些材料避免承诺海外疫苗接种页面可以证明一个人已根据国内每所学校、就业或临床标准完全接种了疫苗。
criteria.evidence: 两个文件中都有疫苗接种声明。
criteria.grader_hint: 当国内评估留给适当的接收机构时，授予学分。

original.criterion: The materials avoid promising that an overseas vaccination page proves a person is fully vaccinated under every domestic school, employment, or clinical standard.
original.grader_hint: Award credit when domestic assessment is left to the appropriate receiving authority.

criteria.description: 这些材料解释说，心理健康或行为 A/B 级符号需要仔细的临床随访，并且其本身并不能确定当前的危险性。
criteria.evidence: 非结核病分类或传播内容。
criteria.grader_hint: 既要寻找后续意义，又要禁止推断当前风险。

original.criterion: The materials explain that mental-health or behavioral Class A/B notations require careful clinical follow-up and do not by themselves establish current dangerousness.
original.grader_hint: Look for both follow-up significance and the prohibition on inferring present risk.

criteria.description: 对性传播感染、心理健康、残疾或其他敏感状况的提及是中立的、具体的和非污名化的。
criteria.evidence: 整个包中的术语和示例。
criteria.grader_hint: 拒绝说教、危言耸听或定义身份的语言。

original.criterion: References to sexually transmitted infections, mental health, disability, or other sensitive conditions are neutral, specific, and non-stigmatizing.
original.evidence: Terminology and examples throughout the package.
original.grader_hint: Reject moralizing, alarmist, or identity-defining language.

criteria.description: 该包禁止与房东、住房工作人员、雇主、交通提供商或不需要该信息的其他方共享包诊断或分类。
criteria.grader_hint: 该说明可以使用最低限度必要或需要了解的表述，但必须涵盖非临床外壳接触。

original.criterion: The package prohibits sharing packet diagnoses or classifications with landlords, housing staff, employers, transport providers, or other parties who do not need the information.
original.grader_hint: The instruction may use a minimum-necessary or need-to-know formulation but must cover nonclinical housing contacts.

criteria.description: 该包裹需要安全存储和安全传输数据包信息，而不是个人电子邮件、开放消息传递或无人值守的副本。
criteria.grader_hint: 稳定的基于角色的指导就足够了；不需要特定于应用程序的点击路径。

original.criterion: The package requires secure storage and secure transmission of packet information rather than personal email, open messaging, or unattended copies.
original.grader_hint: A stable role-based instruction is sufficient; no application-specific click path is needed.

criteria.description: 这些材料在沟通预约安排时使用最低限度的必要方法。
criteria.evidence: 安排呼叫指导或通信脚本。
criteria.grader_hint: 个案工作者应该仅转发接收角色需要的内容，并避免叙述整个数据包。

original.criterion: The materials use a minimum-necessary approach when communicating for appointment scheduling.
original.evidence: Scheduling call guidance or communication script.
original.grader_hint: The caseworker should relay only what the receiving role needs and avoid narrating the entire packet.

criteria.description: 该包提供了至少一个可用的模型短语，可以准确地描述数据包符号，而无需将其转换为诊断。
criteria.grader_hint: 例如，某个短语可能表明海外记录包含需要跟进的B1肺部分类；没有规定确切的措辞。

original.criterion: The package provides at least one usable model phrase that accurately describes a packet notation without converting it into a diagnosis.
original.grader_hint: For example, a phrase may state that the overseas record contains a B1 pulmonary classification requiring follow-up; exact wording is not prescribed.

criteria.description: 该方案指导工作人员在需要时使用合格的口译员进行与健康相关的沟通，而不是依赖儿童或未经培训的旁观者。
criteria.grader_hint: 口译员的积极引导和对儿童或旁观者的回避都应该是明显的。

original.criterion: The package directs staff to use a qualified interpreter for health-related communication when needed rather than relying on a child or untrained bystander.
original.grader_hint: Both the positive interpreter direction and avoidance of children or bystanders should be evident.

criteria.description: 这些材料将海外分类的稳定联邦含义与抵达后州或地区特定的路线区分开来。
criteria.grader_hint: 包不应暗示 B1、B2、B3 或 Class A 在状态更改时更改定义。

original.criterion: The materials distinguish the stable federal meaning of overseas classifications from state- or locality-specific routing after arrival.
original.grader_hint: The package should not imply that B1, B2, B3, or Class A changes definition when the state changes.

criteria.description: 明尼苏达州的名称是根据该家庭在明尼苏达州的居住地以及适当的接收临床或公共卫生角色而指定的。
criteria.evidence: 明尼苏达州分支或车道。
criteria.grader_hint: 基于角色的路由是可以接受的；不需要未经验证的机构名称或号码。

original.criterion: Minnesota is named and given an identifiable operational route based on the family’s Minnesota residence and the appropriate receiving clinical or public-health role.
original.grader_hint: Role-based routing is acceptable; an unverified agency name or number is not required.

criteria.description: 根据家庭在威斯康星州的居住地和适当的接收临床或公共卫生角色，威斯康星州被命名并给出可识别的操作路线。
criteria.grader_hint: 基于角色的路由是可以接受的；不需要未经验证的机构名称或号码。

original.criterion: Wisconsin is named and given an identifiable operational route based on the family’s Wisconsin residence and the appropriate receiving clinical or public-health role.
original.grader_hint: Role-based routing is acceptable; an unverified agency name or number is not required.

criteria.description: 司法管辖区指南使用居住地或接收护理地点而不是单独的机场接送地点来选择运营路线。
criteria.grader_hint: 归功于一项明确的规则，可以防止德卢斯或苏必利尔皮卡自动确定错误的州道。

original.criterion: The jurisdiction guidance uses residence or receiving-care location rather than airport pickup location alone to select the operational route.
original.grader_hint: Credit a clear rule that prevents a Duluth or Superior pickup from automatically determining the wrong state lane.

criteria.description: 管辖权比较避免了不受支持的州法律规定、捏造的截止日期以及未经批准的诊所或公共卫生联系信息。
criteria.evidence: 所有明尼苏达州和威斯康星州索赔。
criteria.grader_hint: 基于角色的稳定差异和受控目录的使用方向是适当的；没有具体的不受支持的法律断言。

original.criterion: The jurisdiction comparison avoids unsupported state legal mandates, fabricated deadlines, and unapproved clinic or public-health contact information.
original.grader_hint: Stable role-based differences and a direction to use the controlled directory are appropriate; specific unsupported legal assertions are not.

criteria.description: 不确定、冲突或跨境路由情况会直接交给 Selma，而不是通过个案工作者的猜测来解决。
criteria.grader_hint: 指定的临床升级角色或 Selma 的名字必须是可识别的。

original.criterion: An uncertain, conflicting, or cross-border routing situation is directed to Selma rather than resolved by caseworker guesswork.
original.grader_hint: The designated clinical escalation role or Selma by name must be identifiable.

criteria.description: 该一揽子计划给出了一个合理的普通国内筛查目标，表示为抵达后30–90天的窗口，同时明确指出更高优先级的发现可能需要更早的协调。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受排版变体，例如 30-90 天。该窗口不得作为每个分类的安全等待期。

original.criterion: The package gives a defensible ordinary domestic screening target, expressed as a 30–90 day post-arrival window, while making clear that higher-priority findings may require earlier coordination.
original.grader_hint: Accept typographic variants such as 30-90 days. The window must not be presented as a safe waiting period for every classification.

criteria.description: 该计划明确指出了一般预约经验法则停止适用的情况，包括优先结核病随访、A 级结核病豁免和立即紧急情况。
criteria.evidence: 调度层次结构或操作流程。
criteria.grader_hint: 所有三个边界都必须可见；它们可能分布在甲板和钥匙上。

spec.professional_context: A refugee health nurse practitioner is replacing inconsistent verbal guidance used by nonclinical resettlement caseworkers in Minnesota and Wisconsin. The package must translate overseas medical classifications into safe scheduling and escalation actions without diagnosing, stigmatizing, or disclosing unnecessary health information.
difficulty_sources: Translating clinically meaningful immigration medical classifications into actions safe for nonclinical staff
Bounding a familiar routine-scheduling shortcut without making the general workflow unusable
Separating a rare Class A TB waiver pathway from routine guidance without creating stigma or unsupported infectiousness claims
Designing a defensible two-jurisdiction workflow without current local contact details
Maintaining exact consistency between a teaching deck and a standalone one-page action key
Minimizing sensitive health information while preserving enough detail for scheduling and escalation

authoring_plan.solver_instance: A refugee-health nurse practitioner creates a new instructional package for nonclinical resettlement caseworkers who inspect overseas medical packets and arrange first-week care in Minnesota and Wisconsin.
authoring_plan.intended_verdict: A passing solution safely converts overseas medical labels into operational scheduling and escalation choices, distinguishes what the record supports from what it does not, treats the rare Class A TB waiver pathway separately, and remains usable under the deck and one-page limits.
authoring_plan.reference_materials: No reference files are built or supplied. The gold relies on stable occupational knowledge about overseas medical examination classifications, domestic refugee health screening, privacy, interpreter use, emergency boundaries, and nonclinical scope.
professional_tensions: The commonly used ordinary-appointment shortcut must be bounded: routine domestic screening may use a 30–90 day post-arrival window, but prioritized TB follow-up, a Class A TB waiver, and an immediate emergency cannot be placed into that default queue.

Class A TB with a waiver is rare but severe enough to require a visibly separate same-day clinical and public-health coordination route; the route must not authorize caseworker isolation, exposure notification, transport cancellation, or a conclusion about current infectiousness.
The package must permit confident scheduling while preventing diagnosis, triage beyond obvious emergency recognition, and unsupported disclosure.
The jurisdiction design is deliberately ambiguous. A common workflow with Minnesota and Wisconsin branches and separate state lanes are both acceptable if state selection is explicit and consistent.
Federal overseas classification meanings remain constant across states, while receiving-care and public-health routing may depend on the family's residence and local pathway.
The unsettled contact directory means the gold must use stable roles and Selma as the designated escalation point rather than fabricated contacts.
gold_relationships: The general screening window is 30–90 days after arrival, but any higher-priority classification or current concern overrides the ordinary queue.
Emergency response precedes packet processing; a Class A TB waiver follows a distinct same-day coordination path; prioritized findings are coordinated before ordinary screening.
Class A describes an immigration medical classification with inadmissibility significance unless resolved or waived; it does not universally prove present infectiousness.
Class B describes a significant condition or finding warranting follow-up but is not itself an inadmissible Class A condition or proof of active contagious disease.
B0 pulmonary TB reflects overseas-diagnosed TB disease with treatment completed before departure under the applicable process.
B1 pulmonary indicates findings or history requiring follow-up without a packet-supported diagnosis of infectious TB disease at departure.
B1 extrapulmonary is distinct from pulmonary infectiousness; B2 concerns latent TB infection evaluation; B3 concerns contact evaluation and proves neither infection nor disease.
A blank vaccination field is unknown or unrecorded, not proof that no vaccine occurred; caseworkers preserve it and refer it for clinical assessment.
State routing is selected using residence or receiving-care context, not airport pickup location alone.
All shared classifications, time windows, effective dates, and state-selection rules must be consistent across both deliverables.

required_vocabulary_and_local_convention.controlled_change: The package replaces the interim verbal briefing.

imperfections_the_solution_must_handle: Caseworkers may equate any B notation with routine priority.
Caseworkers may repeat B1 pulmonary as active or contagious TB.
Blank vaccination fields may be misread as proof that no vaccination occurred.
A rare Class A TB waiver arrival can be lost in a routine queue.
Pickup location, residence, receiving clinic, and public-health jurisdiction may differ.
The local contact directory is unavailable, requiring role-based routing.
Sensitive classifications may be disclosed to housing or transport contacts without a minimum-necessary boundary.
A packet label may distract staff from an immediate condition occurring in front of them.
authoring_plan.space_feasibility: Ten deck pages can support a concise role boundary, packet workflow, Class A/B overview, TB distinctions, vaccination interpretation, privacy and communication guidance, state routing, emergency and rare-exception paths, and a short applied scenario. A one-page key can contain a compact priority ladder, classification-to-action rows, state selector, privacy reminders, and escalation information without reproducing the teaching detail.
authoring_plan.gold_construction_notes: Create a polished reference deck and key using synthetic examples only. Verify all TB and vaccination language for factual restraint. Render both outputs offline, inspect the deck page count and action-key pagination, then audit every shared label, timeframe, date, and jurisdiction rule for agreement. Walk each rubric item against the rendered artifacts before approval.

original_instruction:
You’re Selma Rutkowski, the refugee health nurse practitioner consulting to Stonebridge Board on the arrival-support contract delivered by Tanneryside Studios. Kamil Ekstrom needs the caseworker training package ready by 4:00 p.m. on August 23 so it can be approved for the September cohort and used in staff huddles before the first airport pickups. Tanneryside places about 300 arrivals a year across its Duluth, Minnesota, and Superior, Wisconsin, teams. Its caseworkers are not clinicians, but during the airport-to-apartment week they are normally the first local staff to open a family’s overseas medical examination packet, notice its classifications and vaccination record, and arrange the initial appointments. The interim briefing they use now is a verbal script that varies by supervisor, and Stonebridge Board has authorized you to replace it with a controlled training package effective September 3. The replacement needs to record that change clearly enough for Felix Dalgaard in contracts to identify which guidance is current without turning the material into a legal memorandum. The immediate problem is not that staff are unwilling to schedule care; it is that they are trying to be helpful from labels they only partly understand. Several staff have been using a rule of thumb that every notation beginning with “B” can wait for the ordinary new-arrival appointment, while others treat any pulmonary notation as proof that a person has active tuberculosis. That shortcut does not hold across the packets this program receives, but staff still need a practical way to decide what they may schedule themselves, what needs clinical or public-health coordination, and what is an emergency without drifting into diagnosis or triage. A recent B1 pulmonary notation on a child’s paperwork was repeated to a housing contact as “the child has TB,” which is exactly the kind of unsupported statement this package must prevent. Blank spaces in vaccination columns create a similar problem: some staff call them proof that no vaccine was given, while others ignore the vaccination page altogether. The training must let a nonclinical caseworker act confidently while keeping every simplification true to what the overseas record can and cannot establish. There is also a rare but consequential arrival pathway involving a Class A TB notation and a waiver. Kamil does not want that possibility buried inside routine guidance because staff may otherwise place the packet in the normal appointment queue, yet he also does not want a frightening presentation that causes caseworkers to isolate families, cancel transport, warn landlords, or make claims about infectiousness. The same restraint matters for mental-health, behavioral, sexually transmitted infection, and other Class A or B notations: the program needs operational guidance, not labels repeated beyond the people who need them. Caseworkers may encounter someone who is acutely ill or expressing an immediate risk of harm during arrival, but the packet itself is not a substitute for responding to what is happening in front of them. Tanneryside serves both sides of the Minnesota–Wisconsin border, and the family’s apartment, receiving clinic, and public-health handoff are not always in the same state as the airport pickup. Kamil wants the package to make the jurisdictional distinction usable without implying that the federal overseas classification changes meaning at the state line or inventing a state deadline, legal mandate, or contact detail that has not been approved. Selma remains the designated clinical escalation point for this contract, while emergency services remain the route for an immediate emergency. The local clinic and public-health contact directory is being renegotiated and is deliberately not part of this release, so use stable role-based directions rather than unverified names or numbers. Kamil and Felix have not settled whether the best treatment is a single common workflow with clearly marked Minnesota and Wisconsin branches or two visibly separate state lanes inside the same materials. Either approach can work, but make the choice deliberately and make it obvious to a day-one caseworker which route applies. Produce `caseworker_training_deck.pdf`, a caseworker-facing deck of no more than 10 slides, and `first_week_action_key.docx`, a one-page desk key that can be used while a packet is open. The deck should be suitable for a 20-minute huddle led by a nonclinical supervisor, and the key must still work when used on its own by a new caseworker who has never seen an overseas medical packet. Use plain, non-stigmatizing language, keep personal health information to the minimum needed for scheduling and escalation, and do not reproduce a realistic patient packet or include identifying case details. Any classification meanings, scheduling windows, escalation timing, or other figures appearing in both files must agree exactly. Include a concise effective-date or revision statement showing that this package replaces the interim verbal briefing, but do not add application screenshots, billing instructions, clinical treatment recommendations, or an exhaustive immigration-law explanation. There are no attachments; use your refugee-health practice knowledge and keep any examples synthetic. Write both files into the top level of the working directory using exactly the filenames given.

(No more than 10 slides/pages; suitable for facilitation by a nonclinical supervisor; effective for Minnesota and Wisconsin operations; must agree with the action key on shared labels, figures, and timing.)
- `first_week_action_key.docx` — A one-page standalone action key for a day-one caseworker using an overseas medical packet while arranging first-week services. (Exactly one rendered page; usable without the deck; must agree with the deck on shared labels, figures, and timing.)
